In detail

Milbertshofen-Am Hart is one of Munich's 25 official Stadtbezirke (city districts). Polizeipraesidium Muenchen and the Statistisches Amt Muenchen recorded 3,254 total offences here in 2025, across a population of 77,281 residents (31 December 2024) — a rate of 4,211 offences per 100,000 residents, close to the citywide average. This rate is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy central, station, or nightlife-heavy district can read higher without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential district can show a low rate simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's official-data layer for Munich — real Polizeipraesidium Muenchen / Statistisches Amt Muenchen figures, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data is not split here by time of day, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Milbertshofen-Am Hart safe?

Wandroz currently rates Milbertshofen-Am Hart in Munich as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Munich. This rating is derived from Polizeipräsidium München's official recorded-offence statistics — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats. The source data has no day/night breakdown, so this single rating applies at any time of day rather than being a distinct night-specific figure.
